title: Fee History and the Reinstatement Fee on Crestline Credits
content:
The reinstatement-fee fee-history rate on a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers looks at the service fees already charged on that credit.

**The rule.** The fee-history rate is 0.80 when the service fees charged on the credit, less the service fees refunded on it, come to at least 50 US dollars. It is 0.90 when they come to more than zero but less than 50 US dollars, and 1 when they come to zero.

## Questions on the rule

**Which fees count?**
The service fees charged on the credit, meaning its extension, reinstatement and telephone redemption fee entries, less the service fees refunded on it.

**What if a fee was charged and then refunded?**
The refunded amount comes off. A fee of 25.00 that was refunded in full leaves a net figure of zero, and the rate is 1.

**Is 50 US dollars itself in the upper band?**
Yes. A net figure of exactly 50.00 gives 0.80.

## Hypothetical fee histories

| Service fees charged | Fees refunded | Net figure | Fee-history rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 99.00 | 0.00 | 99.00 | 0.80 |
| 50.00 | 0.00 | 50.00 | 0.80 |
| 49.99 | 0.00 | 49.99 | 0.90 |
| 25.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 | 0.90 |
| 25.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 1 |
| none | none | 0.00 | 1 |
